title: Fix GitHub OAuth first-admin TOCTOU race
description:
## Source
Audit swarm finding F-AG5-08 / F36 (memorysmith-staticanalysis2-audit-26-07-14-23-38-09)

## Problem
GitHub OAuth first-admin bootstrap has a TOCTOU (time-of-check-time-of-use) race: `HasAnyAdminAsync()` is checked, then across multiple awaited I/O operations, `AssignRoleAsync(Admin)` is called. Two concurrent sign-ins can both observe `false` for `HasAnyAdminAsync()` and both become Admin. TSK-0289 fixed the authorization gap but not this concurrency gap.

## Severity
**High** — two simultaneous first sign-ins both become admin, subverting intended bootstrap security

## Files
- `MemorySmith.App/Services/GitHubOAuthCallbackHandler.cs` lines 107-148

## Recommendation
Use atomic `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` transaction or `INSERT OR IGNORE` sentinel row for first-admin claim. Add concurrency test.

Effort: 4-6 hours including concurrency test.

## Existing Coverage
Extends TSK-0289 (Done) — fixed authorization but not concurrency.
